lines.en: Wrapped in bandages. My walk is stiff.
Wrappings drag. Rasping sound.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，膝盖不太弯。
lines.en: Step by step. Knees barely bend.
I come from the sarcophagus.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候，布裂了一道。
lines.en: When I raised my arm, a wrap tore.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，地上有灰。
lines.en: Ash on the floor where I pass.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，不快也不慢。
lines.en: Toward you. Neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 身上的布很旧，一动就散。
lines.en: Old wrappings. They shed as I move.
My toes show. Very dry.

lines.zh: 我转弯的时候要停一下。
lines.en: I pause when I turn.
Closing in. Steady.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，像从沙里出来。
lines.en: I drag along like something out of sand.
I stand. The wrappings hang.
Mouth open. No sound.
Dry here. Suits me.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾经是个王。
lines.en: I remember being a king.

lines.zh: 我把手举到眼前，布散了。
lines.en: I raise a hand. The cloth unravels.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，只需要站着。
lines.en: I need no breath. Only to stand.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在布里，看不见。
lines.en: My eyes are in the cloth. Useless.

lines.zh: 这里的地面冰凉，我感觉得到。
lines.en: The floor is cold. I feel it.
Under the bandages, my neck turns easily.
Sand falls off me.
You stand before me. Too close.
Head tilted. Stiff neck.
The cloth on you. I know that kind.
I raise my hand. Wrappings unfold.
You're much younger than me.
I have no eyelids — how would I blink?

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声，我听得清清楚楚。
lines.en: Your breathing. Perfectly clear.

lines.zh: 沙漏翻了多少次，我记不清。
lines.en: I lost count of how often the hourglass turned.
You retreat. Prints left behind.
These wrappings are my armor.
One wrapping came loose.
Half a step back. Stiffly.

lines.zh: 你砍到的是布，不是骨头。
lines.en: You cut cloth. Not bone.
That didn't put me down.
I rewrap it.
You can't kill me twice.

lines.zh: 我身上掉了一块干的东西。
lines.en: A dry piece of me fell away.

lines.zh: 绷带下的头，慢慢转过来。
lines.en: The head beneath the bandages turns slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记在很久以前了。
lines.en: That one I'll file with the old ones.
You're still here. Good.
Leave the offering at my feet; I won't touch it.
Why hold that up?
I want only your place.
Put it down. Go to the door.
Useless to the dead.

lines.zh: 我不需要食物，也不需要水。
lines.en: No food. No water.
You'll tire holding that.
I'm not approaching for that.
You smell very alive.
Put your things away.
You hit the wrappings. Hard.
Half a step back. Wraps loosened.

lines.zh: 我身上有沙子，蹭到你了。
lines.en: Sand on me. Some got on you.
That bent my arm out of line.
This close, I can grab.
I crowd you against the sarcophagus.
The impact didn't shake me apart. Good.
I yield. Slowly.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到我的脸，冷的吧。
lines.en: You touched my face. Cold, isn't it.
My bandages brush you and begin to split.

lines.zh: 我早就已经死了很多年。
lines.en: I've been dead many years.

lines.zh: 这身布下面没有东西了。
lines.en: There's nothing left under these wraps.
Whatever you want. I give nothing.
Come close and the ash gets on you.
My heart stopped long ago.
Back away. Leave the wrappings.
I guard a sarcophagus. Not people.
Your breathing unsettles me.
It's quiet here. You should go.
Any closer and I strike.

lines.zh: 我用僵直的手指夹起来。
lines.en: I pinch it with stiff fingers.
A wrap coils around it and lifts.

lines.zh: 这东西有我那个年代的样式。
lines.en: This is from my era.
Up to my eye. The cloth blocks it.

lines.zh: 地上有沙子，我一并收了。
lines.en: Sand on the floor. Taking that too.
Into the wrappings.

lines.zh: 这点重量，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: I barely feel the weight.
Yours. I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 它在我手里变得更旧了。
lines.en: It aged in my hand.

lines.zh: 我盯着看，想不起来是什么。
lines.en: I stare. Can't recall what it is.
You stepped in here.
I raise my head. The cloth moves.

lines.zh: 这石棺附近，不该有活人。
lines.en: No living thing near this sarcophagus.
You moved. Then you've broken it.
I've started walking. Not fast.
Under these wraps, I never tire.
One exit on this floor.

lines.zh: 裹着我的布，已经黑透了。
lines.en: The cloth wrapping me is black through.
I spread my hands. The wraps open.

lines.zh: 你举着武器，那就这样吧。
lines.en: You've raised a weapon. So be it.

lines.zh: 我锁定你之后，会走到底。
lines.en: Once I lock on, I walk to the end.
I know this stretch well.
You retreat. Not far.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有声音，只有沙。
lines.en: My steps make no sound. Only sand.
Now I'm serious.

lines.zh: 你背后的沙，正在往下淌。
lines.en: The sand behind you is already pouring down.
Look at these wrappings.
Don't be afraid. It ends soon.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，脚步很均匀。
lines.en: Step by step. Even pace.
You retreat. I don't speed up.
My wrappings drift.
Your weapon won't stop sand.
I raise my arm. Joints creak.
There's a place beside the sarcophagus.
You head for the pillar. Dead end.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在布里看着你。
lines.en: My eyes watch you from inside the cloth.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，所以不会喘息。
lines.en: I don't breathe. So I never gasp.
Your arms are tired already.

lines.zh: 这一片的地砖，我踩过很多次。
lines.en: I've crossed these tiles many times.

lines.zh: 我停下来，是因为你不动。
lines.en: I stopped because you stopped.
Listen. Sand falling.
One more step and you're at the wall.
This foot of mine is up.
By the sarcophagus. Now.
Stop struggling. No use.

lines.zh: 这里的空气很干，适合保存。
lines.en: Dry air here. Good for preserving.
You'll stay here.
Forever, by this sarcophagus.

lines.zh: 我一挥手，布抽在你身上。
lines.en: One sweep. The wrappings lash you.
The cloth wraps your wrist.
Eighteen points of armour — your blade won't bite.
What's wrapped in these bandages is stone.
You're shoved into the sarcophagus.

lines.zh: 这一下，我肋骨响了一声。
lines.en: That clicked one of my ribs.
My fingers are hard. Like wood.
Cloth caught your feet. You fell.

lines.zh: 这一掌，我压着你的胸口。
lines.en: That palm on your chest.
Sand in your eyes.
Step for step, I am no slower.
My wraps come looser with each blow. Good.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用尽了这具身体。
lines.en: That used all this body has.
You're gasping. I don't need to.
I hold you down and show you the sarcophagus.
There's room in there.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的手臂动不了。
lines.en: Now your arm won't move.
My teeth are showing.
No need to shout. Nobody hears.
The wrappings fall. Covered.

lines.zh: 石棺的盖子往旁边移了。
lines.en: The sarcophagus lid slid aside.
I sit up out of the wrappings.
Sand streams off me.

lines.zh: 我在这个位置上等了很久。
lines.en: I've waited long in this spot.
My hand comes out first.

lines.zh: 这里的空气一碰我就变干。
lines.en: The air dries at my touch.

lines.zh: 我站直了，布条慢慢垂下。
lines.en: I straighten. The wrappings settle.

lines.zh: 地砖上有我的影子，很瘦。
lines.en: A thin shadow on the tiles. Mine.
I raise my head toward the exit.

lines.zh: 我身上的味道，是很旧的香。
lines.en: On me, the smell of very old incense.

lines.zh: 封条断了，我从棺里坐起。
lines.en: The seal broke and I sat up in my coffin.
I step out. One step, one pause.
Fire on the wraps. I burn bright.

lines.zh: 摔到地上，骨头断了几根。
lines.en: Fell. A few bones snapped.

lines.zh: 水浸了布，重得抬不起手。
lines.en: Water in the wraps. Too heavy to move.

lines.zh: 炸得我身上的布全散了。
lines.en: The blast stripped my wrappings.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在绷带里，拔不出。
lines.en: The arrowhead is stuck in my bandages.

lines.zh: 这东西让我身上的旧咒在响。
lines.en: That set the old curses humming.

lines.zh: 我早已没有饥饿，只有空。
lines.en: No hunger left. Only emptiness.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了我的脸，很难看吧。
lines.en: Lightning showed my face. Unpleasant, isn't it.
Falling. The wrappings come apart.
